auth_method.description: AuthMethod: unset sends the password in plain text; ssmtp.conf(5) names cram-md5 as the other method.

auth_pass.description: AuthPass: password for SMTP AUTH (a secret — prefer a vault reference).

auth_user.description: AuthUser: user name for SMTP AUTH.

from_line_override.description: FromLineOverride: may users set their own From: address. Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

hostname.description: Hostname: the full hostname. Unset: ssmtp asks the host (the postinst wrote the install-time name here).

mailhub.description: Mailhub: the host mail is relayed to, optionally host:port (no MX lookup).

rewrite_domain.description: RewriteDomain: the domain mail appears to come from. Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

root_user.description: Root: who gets all mail for userids < 1000; empty disables the rewriting.

tls_cert.description: TLSCert: client certificate file for the mailhub.

use_tls.description: UseTLS: talk TLS to the mailhub.
